facts.summary: Fibrosis improvement missed statistical significance despite MASH resolution win · Phase 2b · pemvidutide in MASH · not yet approved

evidence.summary: The effects on fibrosis improvement without worsening of MASH in an ITT analysis were 31.8% and 34.5% for pemvidutide 1.2 mg and 1.8 mg, respectively compared with 25.9% for placebo (differences not statistically significant).
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Trial met its primary endpoint with statistically significant MASH resolution without worsening of fibrosis in up to 59.1% of participants in an ITT analysis
evidence.safety: Pemvidutide also demonstrated favorable safety and tolerability, with 0.0% and 1.2% adverse events (AE) related discontinuations in the pemvidutide 1.2 mg and 1.8 mg groups versus 2.4% in the placebo group, and there were no serious adverse events (SAEs) related to study medication.
